name: browser-use
headline: Ruler - Standardize AI Coding Instructions
short_description: Ruler standardizes coding instructions across AI agents, ensuring consistent behavior. Operations teams benefit from uniform code generation, reducing errors and improving collaboration. Integrates with GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other coding assistants.
author: intellectronica

sections.overview:
Ruler is a configuration management tool that centralizes coding instructions for AI agents, enabling teams to maintain consistent behavior across tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. It works by storing standardized agent configurations in AGENTS.md files, which are then read by compatible AI coding assistants. The tool solves the problem of instruction drift and inconsistent code generation across different agents and team members. Development teams benefit from reduced errors and improved collaboration when all agents follow the same coding standards. Ruler supports multiple agent types including Cursor, Gemini, Qwen, and others through a unified configuration approach.
Centralize AI assistant configurations to ensure consistent coding guidelines across multiple tools.
Automate the distribution of context-specific instructions to various AI agents in complex project structures.
Reduce onboarding time for new AI tools by providing a single source of truth for all agent instructions.
Eliminate duplicated efforts by managing all AI agent configurations from a dedicated directory.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/intellectronica/ruler`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
